## Task (user m00001, verbatim intent)
Build from scratch a full-screen interactive site 「GARGANTUA — Schwarzschild Black Hole Raytracer」 in /home/dog/projects/blackhole. Native HTML/CSS/JS + ES Modules + LOCAL Three.js, no build step, static-server runnable. Core MUST be a full-screen Fragment Shader integrating Schwarzschild null geodesics in real time — NO fake black sphere/plane ring/textures/video/screenshots. Required: event horizon, photon ring, multiple accretion-disk crossings, procedural starfield+Milky Way, gravitational lensing, Doppler beaming, gravitational redshift, dynamic disk turbulence. Post: HDR Bloom, ACES, vignette, film grain, slight chromatic aberration; black hole deep black, disk hot/bright, crisp critical structure. Features: cinematic camera loop, OrbitControls, 4 view presets, HUD, 21 parameters, debug views 0–9, hotkeys, optional ambient music. Quality tiers Standard/High/Cinematic, mobile, Retina, state persistence, WebGL error recovery, URL screenshot automation API. Deliver ALL source + vendor + audio assets + launch command + test results; guarantee no console errors, no black screen, pass visual+interaction acceptance. **User added: accretion disk must have VOLUME (3D, like volumetric clouds), not 2D.**

## Environment (verified)
- CWD /home/dog/projects/blackhole existed, empty. node v25.9.0, npm 11.12.1, python3 3.13.13, chromium-browser + google-chrome available (for headless testing).
- npm registry reachable via proxy (env http_proxy/https_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:20172). three.js NOT present locally → vendored via npm.
- AGENTS.md rules: temp/debug files → ~/tmp or project tmp/ (NOT /tmp); no non-human PR merges; read project AGENTS.md first; don't act unilaterally without user discussion (esp. for glm5.3); sandbox network only ports 8199 (model svc) + 20176 (git proxy) allowed.

## Three.js vendoring (DONE)
- Installed three@0.185.1 to /tmp/three-vendor, copied into project preserving structure:
  - vendor/three/build/three.module.js (636K)
  - vendor/three/LICENSE
  - vendor/three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/{EffectComposer,RenderPass,ShaderPass,UnrealBloomPass,Pass,MaskPass}.js  (FullScreenQuad is exported FROM Pass.js, no separate file)
  - vendor/three/examples/jsm/shaders/{CopyShader,LuminosityHighPassShader}.js
  - vendor/three/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js
- EffectComposer defaults its render targets to HalfFloatType (HDR) — good.
- UnrealBloomPass additively blends bloom OVER the input buffer (uses blendMaterial/CopyShader AdditiveBlending) → after it, readBuffer = scene+bloom (still HDR).
- Import map plan: "three" → ./vendor/three/build/three.module.js ; "three/addons/" → ./vendor/three/examples/jsm/ . Addons import bare 'three' (resolved by import map) + relative paths (work because structure preserved).

## Post pipeline decision
RenderPass(raytracer fullscreen-quad scene, ortho cam) → UnrealBloomPass(strength,threshold) → final custom ShaderPass (chromatic aberration + ACES + vignette + grain → screen). Raytracer = fullscreen triangle/quad with ShaderMaterial; pass perspective camera's position + matrixWorld as uniforms (uCamPos, uCamMat). Do ACES+sRGB in final shader; set renderer.toneMapping=NoToneMapping to avoid double tonemap. Custom ShaderMaterial does NOT auto-apply sRGB, so toSRGB() done manually in final pass.

## PHYSICS — VERIFIED CORRECT (the core)
Schwarzschild null geodesic (M=G=c=1), vector form:
  **x'' = -3 L² x / r⁵ ,  L² = |x×v|² (conserved)**
- Horizon r=2, photon sphere r=3, ISCO r=6, critical impact param b_crit=3√3≈5.196.
- Verified: (a) radial eq r̈=(r-3)Ω² matches energy integral ṙ²+L²(1-2/r)/r²=E²; (b) transverse accel components vanish (purely radial); (c) r0 closest-approach matches exact integral EXACTLY; (d) deflection matches high-precision mpmath exact integral to 4dp: b=10→33.8272°(exact) vs 33.8271°(sim); b=8→49.2016 vs 49.2015; b=6→98.5137 vs 98.5135. b=5.196 captured, b=5.2 escapes.
- NOTE: weak-field 4M/b is NOT valid at b=10 (only 5 horizon radii, strong field → 33.8°). An earlier trapezoidal-rule integral gave wrong 31.53° (numerical artifact) — discarded.
- Integration plan: RK4, adaptive dt = uStepScale*r, MAX_STEPS=1024 hard cap, uSteps per quality (Standard~300/High~512/Cinematic~768). Terminate: r<2 (captured→black), r>42 & dot(p,v)>0 (escaped→sample background).
- Verification scripts in /home/dog/projects/blackhole/tmp/: verify_geodesic.py, exact2.py, definitive2.py (mpmath exact integral + numpy RK4).

## Disk design (volumetric, per user)
- Volume: r∈[uDiskInner=6, uDiskOuter=16], flaring thickness h(r)=uDiskThickness*(r/uDiskInner)^0.75, Gaussian in z, early-out if |z|>4h. Swirling turbulence via differential rotation (omega∝r^-1.5) applied to cartesian input (seam-free) + fbm. Front-to-back Beer-Lambert accumulation: alpha=1-exp(-den*uDiskOpacity*ds), ds=physical step length. T(r)∝(r_in/r)^0.75. Doppler: Keplerian v=1/sqrt(r) tangential, δ=1/(γ(1-vk·nhat)), nhat=-normalize(raydir); beaming δ³; grav redshift sqrt(1-2/r). uDoppler/uRedshift blend effect strength.

## Files written so far
- /home/dog/projects/blackhole/js/shaders.js (13255 bytes) — RAYTRACER_VERT, RAYTRACER_FRAG (full raytracer: noise/fbm, diskColor, diskDensity, diskEmission, stars, background, accel, march with out-params for debug, debugColor, main), POST_VERT, POST_FRAG (CA+ACES Narkowicz+toSRGB+vignette+grain). Debug views 0-9: 0 beauty,1 steps,2 deflection,3 density,4 doppler,5 redshift,6 temp,7 transmittance,8 minR,9 photon-sphere proximity.
- Dirs created: css/ js/ vendor/three/ audio/ tools/ tmp/

## 21 params planned
Time Scale, Disk Inner, Disk Outer, Disk Thickness, Disk Brightness, Disk Temperature, Disk Opacity, Turbulence, Turbulence Speed, Doppler Beaming, Gravitational Redshift, Star Brightness, Milky Way, Bloom Strength, Bloom Threshold, Exposure, Vignette, Film Grain, Chromatic Aberration, Field of View, Ray Precision(steps).

## Hotkeys planned
Space=play/pause time, C=cinematic, 1-4=presets, 0-9=debug, Q=cycle quality, H=toggle HUD, M=music, S=screenshot, R=reset, F=fullscreen.

## URL screenshot API planned
?shot=1 auto-download PNG after first frame; ?shot=dataurl sets window.__GARGANTUA_SHOT__; camera params az/el/dist/fov; t=sim time; debug/quality/param overrides; expose window.GARGANTUA={screenshot(),setParams()}; set window.__GARGANTUA_READY__.
